text:
Alex W: Quick question — where should alerts for `inference-runtime:kv-cache-miss-rate` go? Right now they hit infra PD and our #infra-alerts channel, but that channel is getting noisy. Thinking: route to eng-oncall only if >10% for 5m, otherwise stay with infra. Thoughts?

Sana K: That makes sense. We have a couple options: change the Datadog monitor tags -> PagerDuty rules, or add a small intermediate webhook that filters. PD routing rules are easiest if we can rely on the severity tag.

Jordy: Agree with Sana. Can you paste the monitor query and current PD service? I can propose a routing rule.

Alex W: Monitor query is basically: `avg(last_5m):avg:inference.runtime.kv_cache_miss{env:prod} by {region} > 0.05` and it's currently severity:warning. PD service is `infra-core-gpu`.

Sana K: If it's severity:warning we should probably keep infra. We can change the monitor to set severity:critical when >0.10 and change PD rule: critical -> eng-oncall, warning -> infra. That preserves noise control.

Maria: +1. Also consider adding prometheus/trace link in the PD payload so whoever gets it can jump straight to traces. We have a playbook snippet: https://redwood-infra.playbooks/pd-routing#kv-cache

Jordy: I'll open a small config change MR for the PD rules. Proposed steps: 1) Update Datadog monitor to emit severity based on threshold, 2) Add PD routing rule, 3) Add trace link in monitor message.

Alex W: Sounds good. Do we need an oncall schedule change? We sometimes have infra oncall covering CPU/GPU infra and eng-oncall covering runtime incidents. I don't want both paged for the same event.

Sana K: No schedule change if routing rules are correct. We'll route by severity. Also add a suppression window so duplicate alerts within 10m collapse.

Jordy: Draft MR: https://git.redwood/infra/pd-routing/merge_requests/42 — includes YAML for PagerDuty rules and monitor patch. PTAL?

oncall-bot: Reminder: Please include runbook link in monitor message to avoid unnecessary escalation.

pd-integ-bot: PagerDuty service `infra-core-gpu` currently has 2 routing rules. New rule draft added as draft-infra-to-eng.

Maria: Can we also add a note in the eng-oncall playbook that for kv_cache_miss we should check prefix-cache hitrate and the last deploy? Small checklist: - confirm model pin, - check recent kernel upgrades, - link to traces.

Alex W: I'll add that checklist to the playbook after Jordy merges the MR. Thanks all — assign to Jordy to follow up.

Jordy: Assigned. I'll aim to get the MR merged today and ping here when live. :thumbsup:
